sentences.text: [solemn] Voyager One just became the first thing we've sent a full light day from Earth.
[pause] And the first voice on it was hiding a Nazi past.
You see, it carries a golden record, a message for any aliens who find it.
Track one is the UN's leader, Kurt Waldheim, promising peace and friendship.
[lowering their voice] So what was he hiding?
For decades, he said he'd spent the war studying law after a wound.
He'd served on a German army staff that helped ship tens of thousands of Jews to the death camps.
Historians never proved he killed anyone. But he knew, and he lied.
America banned him. Austria made him president anyway.
[after a long pause] And Voyager can't be called back. A liar is still saying hello for all of us.
